messages:
Anya (docs): FYI: PR #4821 (docs) is failing the docs build. Dashboards sample YAML in console/observability is throwing a parser error and our cost/latency example has mismatched units. Need quick fix + link sweep before EOD. details: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821
Sam (eng-runtime): Can you paste the CI log or the failing snippet?
Anya (docs): Sure — failing snippet from docs/console/observability/dashboards/sample.yaml:
```yaml
widgets:
  - type: heatmap
    metrics:
      - name: "request_latency"
        unit: ms
      - name: "cost_per_token"
        unit: tokens   # <-- should be usd/token
```
ci-bot: docs-build: error: Invalid unit 'tokens' at docs/console/observability/dashboards/sample.yaml:15
Lin (eng-platform): I can push a tiny PR to fix the unit and indentation, want me to branch off your PR or open a separate one?
Anya (docs): Open separate PR and reference #4821. We want minimal change + changelog entry. Can you also check console samples for other 'tokens' units? @Sam can you run grep for 'unit: tokens' in repo?
Sam (eng-runtime): On it. grep found 3 occurrences: two in console samples, one in playground examples. I'll open a followup PR to update to `usd/token` and add comment about cost calc.
Maria (product): :eyes: would this change affect any customer docs or APIs?
Sam (eng-runtime): No API change. Just how cost is displayed in docs widgets. I added a brief note in PR description stating 'display unit normalization only'.
deploy-bot: CI: docs-build for PR #4821 + #4822 passed. netlify-deploy succeeded :white_check_mark:
Anya (docs): Thanks all — merged both. Quick post-merge: I'll run a short link sweep for any relative links to the old example and add a redirect if needed. @Lin can you add a sanity check to the docs linter to reject unknown 'unit' values?
Lin (eng-platform): Yep, adding a linter rule in #4824, will be small. ETA today.
Anya (docs): :thumbsup: closing thread.
